newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ National strategy committee to meet Mon evening.
newsitem.headline: NZ National strategy committee to meet Mon evening.

text.p: The National Party strategy committee that has to endorse any coalition deal with New Zealand First will meet on Monday evening, National Party president Geoff Thompson said.
Under the party's rules the strategy committee is the body that provides the final, official ratification of the deal National is prepared to offer NZ First.
"Any coalition arrangement is in the hands of that strategy committee," Thompson said. The commitee consists of three members from the party and three from the parliamentary caucus.
National's caucus was beginning a meeting at 2 p.m.
